caption: The drawing depicts a stylized owl perched on top of a cylindrical pedestal. The owl is rendered in shades of dark brown and gray, with exaggerated, rounded eye sockets and a distinct V-shaped brow. Its body is smooth and elongated, and one of its talons is visible gripping the top of the pedestal. The pedestal has a rounded base and gradually narrows upward where the owl sits. The background is an off-white color with areas of subtle discoloration and several irregular, vertical patches of yellowish-brown on the right side and some faint marks scattered around. In the lower right corner of the drawing, the artist's signature "V.L. VANCE." is present.
title: Cast Iron Owl Hitching Post
